newsitem.title: UK: Mirror Group says no plans to sell Live TV.
newsitem.headline: Mirror Group says no plans to sell Live TV.

text.p: Mirror Group said on Wednesday that it had no plans to sell its Live TV cable television channel and added that the asset was "under-rated in value."
Chief executive David Montgomery told a news conference that recent research by consultants working for the company had placed a value of between 50 and 90 million stg on the channel.
Live TV is connected to 1.45 million homes -- 94 percent of all cable homes in the UK -- and has city affiliates to its national channel in London and Birmingham.
Montgomery said there was "no intention to sell" but said it would be "remiss" not to work out its value.
